title: Balakrishna
desc: A money-minded local goon is hired to protect a woman from her family's rivals. However, he, initially, only accepts the job for the money but later falls in love with her.

title: 3BHK
desc: A middle-class family faces various challenges and setbacks as they strive to achieve their dream of owning a home in the city.

title: Kantara
desc: When greed paves the way for betrayal, scheming and murder, a young tribal reluctantly dons the traditions of his ancestors to seek justice.

title: Agent Vikram
desc: Vikram, a cop who is mourning the death of his wife, is assigned to retrieve a missile. He is aided by a highly educated engineer Preethi, who holds the knowledge to disarm the weapon, in his mission.

title: Siren 108
desc: After serving 14 years in prison, a man is released on parole. As he tries to reconnect with his family, he vows revenge against those who wronged him.

title: Velai Illa Raja
desc: A young man decides to protect his uncle from his nefarious enemy and put an end to his tyranny.
